component.name: Flatsonar
component.summary: Open-source Flatpak apps, hunted from everywhere

description.p: Flatsonar finds open-source Flatpak apps wherever they live: Flathub, GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, project-hosted remotes and release bundles, and puts them in one store. Every listing credits the original creators and shows a sponsor button.

You can install anything. Flatsonar reads each app's sandbox permissions and runs a local ClamAV scan before deploying. If something looks dangerous it warns you and asks you to press Sure twice. After that, it's your call.
Looks like the website now, in light and dark, and the install checks work inside the Flatpak.

ul.li: Downloaded apps are unpacked and scanned with ClamAV again when Flatsonar runs as a Flatpak
A progress bar with speed and time left while apps download
ClamAV loads while the download runs, so the scan no longer adds its startup time afterwards
The catalogue lists apps A to Z, with unnamed build templates at the end
